snippet.title: Major Mayhem Steam Trailer
snippet.description:
Major Mayhem is bringing the chaos to PC! 💥

The original over-the-top arcade shooter is back, now on Steam!

Run, jump, dodge and blast your way through hordes of bad guys in this fast-paced, action-packed shooter. Big guns, massive explosions and plenty of ridiculous mayhem!

🎮 Play Major Mayhem on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/search/?term=Major%20Mayhem

#MajorMayhem #SteamGames #PCGaming #ArcadeShooter #RocketJumpGames
